# Hire Charges and Payments
Quillbrook Village Hall is a fictional organisation.

## 1. Scope
1.1 These charges were approved on 12 February 2025.
1.2 They apply to bookings starting on or after 1 April 2025.
1.3 Room availability is governed by hall-bookings.md.

## 2. Room hire
2.1 Main Hall: £24 per hour.
2.2 Meeting Room: £12 per hour.
2.3 Kitchen used with either room: £8 per booking.
2.4 The minimum paid booking is two hours per room.
2.5 Setup and clearing time must be included in paid hours.
2.6 Hire is charged in whole hours, rounded upwards.

## 3. Discounts
3.1 Registered village groups receive 20% off room hire.
3.2 A registered village group must have at least ten local members.
3.3 Groups must provide their membership count before booking.
3.4 The discount does not apply to kitchen or equipment charges.
3.5 No other discounts may be combined with this discount.

## 4. Equipment charges
4.1 Projector: £15 per booking.
4.2 Portable speaker: £10 per booking.
4.3 Folding display boards: £5 per set per booking.
4.4 Equipment may only be hired alongside a room.
4.5 Equipment availability must be confirmed under hall-bookings.md.

## 5. Deposits
5.1 Every booking requires a £30 booking deposit.
5.2 Parties serving alcohol require a £100 damage deposit.
5.3 The damage deposit is separate from the booking deposit.
5.4 The booking deposit counts towards the total hire charge.
5.5 Damage deposit returns follow hall-refunds.md section 4.

## 6. Payment deadlines
6.1 The booking deposit is due within seven calendar days of acceptance.
6.2 The remaining hire charge is due 14 calendar days before the event.
6.3 Bookings made fewer than 14 days ahead require full payment at acceptance.
6.4 Refund eligibility is determined under hall-refunds.md.

12	1.3 The named hirer is responsible for the entire booking.
13	1.4 The hirer must give a contact address and telephone number.
14

16	2.1 Requests may be submitted up to 12 months in advance.
17	2.2 Requests must arrive at least three calendar days before the event.

24	3.1 Monday to Thursday: 08:00 to 22:00.
25	3.2 Friday and Saturday: 08:00 to 23:00.
26	3.3 Sunday: 09:00 to 21:00.
27	3.4 All guests must leave by the relevant closing time.
28	3.5 Setup and clearing must take place within booked hours.
29	
30	## 4. Room capacities
31	4.1 Main Hall: maximum 90 people.
32	4.2 Meeting Room: maximum 24 people.
33	4.3 Combined events may not exceed 100 people in the building.
34	4.4 Capacities include organisers, performers and children.
35	4.5 Fire safety requirements in hall-safety.md also apply.
36	
37	## 5. Access and equipment
38	5.1 Keys are collected from the booking officer by arrangement.
39	5.2 Keys may not be copied or passed to another hirer.
40	5.3 Equipment must be requested when the booking is made.

42	5.5 Hirers must report missing or faulty equipment before use.
43

45	6.1 Changes to dates or rooms require written approval.
46	6.2 A date change counts as cancellation and a new booking.

# Room Booking Rules
Quillbrook Village Hall is a fictional organisation.

## 1. General conditions
1.1 These rules were adopted on 12 February 2025.
1.2 Rooms may be hired by adults aged 18 or over.
1.3 The named hirer is responsible for the entire booking.
1.4 The hirer must give a contact address and telephone number.

## 2. Booking requests
2.1 Requests may be submitted up to 12 months in advance.
2.2 Requests must arrive at least three calendar days before the event.
2.3 The booking officer checks availability before accepting a request.
2.4 A booking is accepted only when written acceptance is issued.
2.5 Payment deadlines are set out in hall-fees.md section 6.
2.6 Failure to pay the booking deposit cancels an accepted booking.

## 3. Opening hours
3.1 Monday to Thursday: 08:00 to 22:00.
3.2 Friday and Saturday: 08:00 to 23:00.
3.3 Sunday: 09:00 to 21:00.
3.4 All guests must leave by the relevant closing time.
3.5 Setup and clearing must take place within booked hours.

## 4. Room capacities
4.1 Main Hall: maximum 90 people.
4.2 Meeting Room: maximum 24 people.
4.3 Combined events may not exceed 100 people in the building.
4.4 Capacities include organisers, performers and children.
4.5 Fire safety requirements in hall-safety.md also apply.

## 5. Access and equipment
5.1 Keys are collected from the booking officer by arrangement.
5.2 Keys may not be copied or passed to another hirer.
5.3 Equipment must be requested when the booking is made.
5.4 Equipment charges follow hall-fees.md section 4.
5.5 Hirers must report missing or faulty equipment before use.

## 6. Changes
6.1 Changes to dates or rooms require written approval.
6.2 A date change counts as cancellation and a new booking.
6.3 Cancellation charges are governed by hall-refunds.md.

- One portable speaker is £10 per booking (§4.2), so £10.
- Three sets of folding display boards are £5 per set per booking (§4.3), so 3 × £5 = £15.

The group discount doesn't apply to equipment (§3.4), so it can't reduce this. Equipment can only be hired alongside a room (§4.4), and the Meeting Room booking meets that. Under `hall-bookings.md` §5.3, the hirer must request the equipment when making the booking.
